name: l-etf
title: Leveraged ETF Backtesting Lab
description: Backtest leveraged-ETF strategies (UPRO, TQQQ, SSO, QLD) over long market history with rolling-window analysis, SMA timing rules, and risk-off switching. Educational/research only — not investment advice.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: Available ETF presets, risk-off assets, and default SMA settings.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Index prices, borrowing rates, or CPI over a date range.

tools.name: get_sma_signals
tools.description: Current SMA buy/sell/hold signal for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100.

tools.name: get_sma_calibration
tools.description: Precomputed best SMA period/buffer per index (cached snapshot).

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: Single-strategy backtest: CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe, trade log, 1x benchmark.

tools.name: run_rolling_window_analysis
tools.description: One strategy across every historical rolling window; returns the outcome distribution.

tools.name: compare_strategies
tools.description: Rank strategy variants (SMA on/off, risk-off assets, SMA periods) over rolling windows.

resources.description: Earliest/latest available data dates per index.

prompts.name: analyze_strategy
prompts.description: Guided end-to-end analysis of a leveraged-ETF strategy.

disclaimer: For educational and research use only. NOT investment advice. Figures are simulated backtests over historical data; past performance does not predict future returns. Leveraged ETFs are high-risk instruments.
